remountAndViewport.expectedViewportBehavior: Core route families should be playable in a normal desktop viewport with no excessive panning.
remountAndViewport.knownRisk: Runtime/source geometry mismatch means browser smoke is the authority for viewport fit.

knownVisualRisks: Cable clutter may still be dense across the console and PA processor/amp area.
